inputs.prompt: Use image 1 for EXACT sheet layout, object positions and silhouettes ONLY. Image 2 is the original illustration for art direction. Redraw fresh high-resolution clean 2D storybook watercolor and colored-pencil game assets: soft peach, butter yellow, muted sage and warm gray, delicate continuous dark warm-gray pencil outlines, matte pigment and fine paper grain INSIDE the painted objects. Keep the original cute round proportions and faces. The drawing must be genuinely flat and hand painted, with no volumetric rendering, no bevel, no gloss, no lighting highlight, no embossed rim, no hard drop shadow, no plastic or candy material. Outside every object use perfectly uniform pure WHITE #ffffff, no paper noise or shadow outside silhouettes, no white sticker border. All silhouettes closed, clean and anti-aliased; no torn furry alpha edge. No text, labels, digits, logos or watermarks. Do not add a scene or rearrange cells. Redraw all SIXTEEN separate animal assets in their original 4 by 4 cells. Keep each animal in its own cell with broad blank white gutters. Preserve the species and coat patterns in each cell, including the paired bunnies as ONE paired asset. Complete and tidy each body outline. No background, no props, no platforms, no house. Keep each individual at its existing angle and center. Do not print a grid or cell boundaries. Preserve eye shape and the warm innocent expressions; do not make plush 3D toys.
inputs.negative_prompt: plastic, 3d, glossy, bevel, embossed, shiny, airbrush, fake fur edges, torn edges, thick white sticker border, jagged pixel outline, text, words, watermark, cell borders, extra objects
